helpers.note: Dimensions::new stores a half width and a height, the engine's entity size; vanilla's EntityDimensions keeps a width (EntityDimensions#makeBoundingBox is cited where the box is made)
Vec3::new and Aabb::new store their components as given (Aabb::ordered reproduces vanilla AABB's corner ordering where a caller needs it); struct constructors
ProjectileTarget::new (a target that nothing excludes) and HitScene::new (one tick's targets, owner and hit state), engine data structures
MinecraftVersion::parse reads a release name into its numbers, the engine's release identity, no vanilla code
MinecraftVersion::new stores a release's numbers
TravelFamily::name, the family's name the bindings report
MovingEntityKind::name, the registry name the bindings report for a kind
Phase::name, the phase's name in a trace the bindings report
ProjectileReaction::name, the reaction's name the bindings report
runs a vehicle tick with the trace on and gives back its result and the recorded moves; the engine's tracing, which vanilla has none of
ProjectileKind::is_thrown: the engine's stand-in for `instanceof ThrowableProjectile`, which family a kind belongs to
ProjectileKind::is_hurting: the engine's stand-in for `instanceof AbstractHurtingProjectile`
FlightHit::is_block: whether the engine's hit is the block arm of its enum, which vanilla reads by the abstract HitResult.getType
sets which Java major's Math every release follows (a replay setting); the engine's switch, no vanilla code
VersionPhysicsProfile::rules, the trait method each release's profile implements with its own values (the values are held to each release's source as profile rules, test/shared-equivalence.test.cjs)
VersionPhysicsRules::default and PhysicsConfig::default: the engine's starting configuration (26.2's rules, the default config), no vanilla method
reads the state's SNEAKING_SPEED attribute value, else the attribute's default 0.3 (Attributes.SNEAKING_SPEED); an input reader
reads a modifier attribute's value, else its default 1.0 (Attributes.AIR_DRAG_MODIFIER, FRICTION_MODIFIER); an input reader
LegacyBoatState::default: a 1.8 boat's speed multiplier starts at 0.07 (1.8.8 Boat's field initializer, a field the mapping leaves unnamed) and the rider input at zero
VersionedBlockStateId::new (a state id of a registered release, refusing any other) and WorldSnapshot::new (an empty world); engine stores
VersionedBlockStateId::version, the release a state id belongs to
VersionedBlockStateId::id, the index into that release's generated block state table
stores a block's properties as the caller gives them, in a chunk not marked unloaded
whether the store holds the chunk as loaded
stores the level's build height and the border the caller gives
the fluid stored for a cell of a loaded chunk
a block's stored collision boxes before 1.13, a box of no height kept (the release's generated shape data, read as stored)
VersionEngine::tick and ReleaseEngine::tick: dispatch to the release's own engine and profile
ReleaseEngine::of names a release's engine by its module
ReleaseEngine::version, the release an engine is for
whether a profile is for its release and keeps the release's behaviour contract; the engine's own check
ticks a release only through a profile that keeps its contract; dispatch plumbing
